title: Triangle inequality for the fourth norm
statement: Let $\\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, and let $f,g:\\Omega\\to\\mathbb R$. The uniform $L^4$ norm of $f+g$ is at most the sum of the uniform $L^4$ norms of $f$ and $g$.
